notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي» names the compiler's father with no name in the text: a relation link (rule 7)
«بعض أصحابه يرفعه إلى» is a gap the text marks (rule 8): an unnamed link in its place, never filled from memory
The Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the saying is his answer
